decisions.executionNote: Orient both grippers downward gradually in their own workspaces; assess wrist views and IK continuity before approaching objects.
Approach left watch and right wooden toy with open downward grippers, maintaining clearance; estimated table geometry needs wrist confirmation.
Lower around the centered left watch and right wooden lion, slightly correct wrist alignment, then close; retention remains unverified.
Hold closed and lift vertically to verify whether watch and lion are retained before transporting them.
RGB indicates both objects lifted. Carry the watch toward the white left basket and lion toward the right half of blue middle basket without crossing arms.
Replan from interrupted pose with smaller translations, descending slightly to preserve reach margin while positioning objects above assigned baskets.

Place lion well inside blue basket and release. Re-approach dropped left watch from above, aiming slightly toward its near band.

Lift and gently tilt the regrasped watch toward white basket; move right arm above the remaining watch for later center staging, never crossing arms.
Left watch slipped; open and re-align clear of basket rim. Center right watch, descend conservatively, and close around its band.
Attempt deeper left watch grasp, keeping clear of rim. Lift right watch vertically to check retention before center staging.
Verify left watch with a vertical lift. Right watch remained on table; reopen and descend farther, correcting toward its center for a lower band grasp.
Left watch is visibly retained; carry it slowly with forward tilt to clear white rim. Align right watch toward the grasp center, close and begin a test lift.
Raise the left watch clear of white rim before any further forward motion; close right around the lower watch band and lift vertically to test retention.
Left watch fell near white rim; reapproach upright from the near side. Retain right watch and bring it to a central staging area on the right, away from baskets.
Correct rejected tensor; no prior motion. Align left with displaced black watch; lower retained right watch to center staging without crossing.
Close left on watch and lift straight clear of rim before transporting. Release right watch at center staging, then approach green pepper from right side.
Raise retained black watch substantially before crossing the rim. Approach green pepper with small corrected motions and slight inward tool tilt, keeping right EE on its side.
Transport black watch over white basket with ample rim clearance and gradual forward tilt. Correct green pepper toward near side, close and test-lift.
Release black watch inside white basket, retreat left toward rabbit. Lift retained green pepper and translate toward the red basket with clearance before advancing.
Lower and close left around wooden rabbit. Carry green pepper forward over red basket using gradual tilt and sufficient rim clearance.
Release green pepper into red basket and withdraw right. Lift rabbit while moving inward on the left, before advancing over the blue rim.

Close securely around the centered red pepper and lift vertically to confirm retention before a center staging move.
Stage retained red pepper close to the workspace boundary, separate from the staged watch; right waits clear so the arms never cross.
Set red pepper down at the boundary and open, then withdraw left toward rabbit before right approaches the staged pepper.
Pepper was displaced left during withdrawal; regrasp it and give the next release a longer stationary opening dwell. Right moves clear.
Pepper is no longer centered after approach; reopen and withdraw vertically/backward for an unobscured head observation before replanning.
Approach staged watch with left tool from its side of the boundary; withdraw right to keep clearance and reveal the tabletop. Pepper location is currently uncertain.
Lower slightly and close around staged watch band, then test-lift. Red pepper is visible again near white basket and will be reapproached later.
Lift staged watch and translate into left workspace while preserving grasp orientation, aiming to clear the white basket rim before advancing.

Descend with the watch ring centered in the open fingers, close with a dwell, and test retention using only a short vertical lift.

Recenter right over watch before low grasp and vertical lift. Raise left clear of objects first, then shift toward displaced rabbit without sweeping the table.
Correct rejected tensor from unchanged observation. Align left above rabbit before lowering; lift watch with right and move to boundary for careful staging.
Grasp rabbit lower around its body. Set watch down at the boundary, open right gripper, and remain stationary to avoid dragging it during release.
Lift rabbit straight upward to verify a lower grasp. Retract right vertically before moving away from the released watch.

Advance retained rabbit above the blue basket with gradual forward tilt and added clearance; retain the grasp until safely inside.

Lift the watch vertically with unchanged orientation and closed fingers to verify retention before transporting it to white basket.

Lower red pepper vertically to the clear staging surface, open, and dwell without any lateral withdrawal so it remains at the boundary.

Begin resetting the empty left arm while right approaches the staged pepper from its own side. Preserve clearance and gradual elbow-up configuration continuity.
Complete gradual left return toward its original pose. Center right around staged pepper, descend to a low grasp and close with a stationary dwell.

Carry the retained red pepper toward the red basket at constant clearance height and grasp orientation; left remains reset.
Advance the retained red pepper over the right interior of its basket with gradual forward tilt, maintaining rim clearance before release.
